hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *pnpm-lock.yaml|*package-lock.json|*yarn.lock|*bun.lockb|*.env|*.env.*) echo 'Blocked: do not edit lockfiles or .env files' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *'git pull'*|*'git merge'*|*'git checkout'*|*'git switch'*) exec "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/graphify-freshness.sh" ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/prettier" ] && "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
